provenance: Reviewed annotations of the cited source guides; no evaluation data used.

guide-sso.title: Single sign-on and identity federation / 单点登录与身份联合
primary_mechanisms: Single sign-on and federation reduce independent password stores by connecting applications to a trusted identity provider through protocols such as SAML or OpenID Connect
SSO and identity federation centralize authentication and consistent MFA policy; session and application access revocation must be tested
Verify issuer, audience, signatures, assertion lifetime and logout behavior, and automate provisioning/deprovisioning where supported.

guide-identity.title: Identity lifecycle / 身份生命周期与权限复核
primary_mechanisms: Identity lifecycle management makes joiner, mover and leaver (JML) access changes timely and auditable
Manage account creation, job changes and termination so access remains aligned with current responsibilities and accountable business owners
Identity lifecycle management ties provisioning, transfers, reviews and timely deprovisioning to accountable owners
Evidence includes approved requests, access certifications and revocation records.

guide-pam.title: Privileged access management / 特权访问管理
primary_mechanisms: Privileged access management reduces misuse of administrative privileges through controlled approval, isolated administrative identity and time-limited privileged sessions
PAM combines separation of administrative identities, credential vaulting, approval, just-in-time time-limited elevation and session auditing
Reviewers verify approvals, expiry enforcement, credential rotation and recorded administrative sessions.

guide-least.title: Least privilege / 最小权限
primary_mechanisms: Least privilege limits subjects to necessary resources and operations, with deny-by-default authorization and regular access review
Test both permitted actions and attempts outside the approved scope.

guide-mfa.title: Phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication / 抗钓鱼多因素认证
primary_mechanisms: Multi-factor authentication combines different factor types; phishing-resistant authentication prevents captured credentials or proxy phishing from authenticating to a different origin
FIDO2/WebAuthn uses origin-bound public-key authentication
Enrollment, lost-device recovery and administrative exceptions need strong verification
Audit coverage of sensitive accounts and test that weak fallback cannot bypass required authentication.

guide-password.title: Password storage / 口令哈希
primary_mechanisms: Salted, deliberately expensive password hashing raises the cost of offline password guessing after a credential database is stolen
Password storage uses a password hashing function such as Argon2id with unique salts and calibrated work factors; a separately protected pepper may add defense
Verify parameters and plan upgrades as hardware and threats evolve.

guide-zero.title: Risk-based conditional access and zero trust / 基于风险的条件访问与零信任
primary_mechanisms: Conditional access evaluates identity, device posture and compliance, location, resource sensitivity and current risk to make adaptive access decisions
It requires stronger authentication where appropriate and blocks non-compliant devices
Validate denied and allowed paths, session revocation and emergency-access procedures.

guide-vulnerability.title: Vulnerability management / 漏洞管理闭环
primary_mechanisms: Closed-loop vulnerability management connects discovery, prioritization, remediation, validation and governed exceptions in a traceable workflow
Vulnerability management needs accountable remediation owners, risk-based deadlines, retesting and time-bound exceptions, rather than scanning reports alone
Evidence includes aging reports, closed tickets and independent verification.

guide-patch.title: Patch management / 补丁管理
primary_mechanisms: Patch and remediation management reduces exposure to known software vulnerabilities by applying and verifying security fixes promptly, with priority for exploitable and externally exposed flaws
Maintain an asset and version inventory, prioritize exploitability, external exposure and business criticality, test representative systems, deploy in stages and verify remediation
Patch management combines inventory, risk prioritization, testing, staged deployment, rollback and post-installation verification, with tracked owners and deadlines.

guide-hardening.title: Secure configuration baseline / 安全配置基线
primary_mechanisms: Configuration baselines should be versioned, tested, enforced and periodically checked for drift
Exceptions have an owner, justification and expiry; remediation and compliance scans provide evidence.

guide-edr.title: Endpoint detection and response / 端点检测与响应
primary_mechanisms: EDR detects malicious endpoint processes, files and persistence, supports investigation and enables containment such as host isolation
Endpoint detection and response requires sensor coverage, maintained detection rules, triage ownership and tested response playbooks
Validate the whole detection-to-response chain with controlled simulations and telemetry checks.

guide-fde.title: Full disk encryption / 全盘加密
primary_mechanisms: Full disk encryption protects stored information when a device is lost, stolen or accessed offline, while authorized running sessions still need access controls

Full disk encryption requires managed deployment, protected boot authentication, secure recovery-key escrow and tested recovery; encryption does not protect data after an authorized session has unlocked it.

guide-allowlist.title: Application allowlisting / 应用白名单
primary_mechanisms: Application allowlisting needs an approved inventory, staged testing, controlled exceptions and ongoing monitoring; verify both approved execution and blocked unknown binaries, including scripts and interpreters where applicable.

guide-sql.title: SQL injection prevention / 参数化查询
primary_mechanisms: Parameterized statements bind values rather than concatenating input into SQL
Dynamic identifiers require an allowlist; database accounts still need least privilege
Verify with malicious input tests and code review of all query construction paths.

guide-xss.title: Cross-site scripting prevention / XSS防护
failure_modes: data interpreted as executable browser script
primary_mechanisms: Context-sensitive output encoding keeps untrusted data from becoming executable browser content
Sanitization and safe APIs are primary controls; Content Security Policy adds defense in depth rather than replacing them.

guide-csrf.title: CSRF protection / CSRF防护令牌
failure_modes: automatic cookie inclusion without request-intent verification
primary_mechanisms: CSRF protection prevents another site from inducing unwanted state-changing requests through a victim authenticated session
CSRF tokens must be secret, unpredictable and session-bound
Origin/Referer validation and appropriate SameSite cookies add defense; state changes should not use GET.

choose_this_when: automatic cookie inclusion without request-intent verification

guide-session.title: Secure session management / 安全会话管理
primary_mechanisms: Secure sessions use unpredictable identifiers, renew them after login or privilege changes, and enforce server-side inactivity and absolute timeouts and logout revocation
Session cookies use Secure, HttpOnly and appropriate SameSite attributes
Verify fixation resistance, token renewal, expiry and revocation rather than relying on client-side deletion alone.
not_primary_when: automatic cookie inclusion without request-intent verification

choose_other_when: automatic cookie inclusion without request-intent verification

guide-sdlc.title: Secure development lifecycle / 安全开发生命周期
failure_modes: security omitted from design and delivery
primary_mechanisms: Threat modeling identifies assets, trust boundaries and abuse cases; code review and security testing verify requirements
Release gates should track findings, owners, remediation and retests, rather than treating a single late penetration test as the entire process.

guide-sca.title: Software composition analysis / 软件成分分析与SBOM
primary_mechanisms: Software composition analysis identifies direct and transitive dependencies, versions, known vulnerabilities and license risks; an SBOM records the component inventory
SCA results need reachability and exposure assessment, responsible owners, upgrade planning and verification
An SBOM is an inventory, not proof that components are secure; continuously correlate it with vulnerability intelligence.

guide-secrets.title: Centralized secrets management / 应用凭据与机密集中管理
primary_mechanisms: Keep application secrets out of source code and distributed configuration by using a controlled vault or workload identity with least-privilege retrieval and audit trails
Secrets management should prefer short-lived credentials, prevent logging or repository exposure, and support rapid revocation
Test rotation without service disruption and verify that old credentials cease working.

guide-cloud-responsibility.title: Cloud shared responsibility / 云责任共担
primary_mechanisms: Cloud shared responsibility requires a documented responsibility matrix, verification of provider assurances and testing of customer-managed controls; outsourcing infrastructure does not transfer all accountability.

guide-security-group.title: Cloud security groups / 安全组最小暴露
primary_mechanisms: Security groups reduce cloud workload exposure to the internet and unnecessary networks by restricting source, destination, protocol and port to required business flows
Security groups minimize network exposure with least-privilege ingress and egress, private connectivity and explicit approved sources
Review stale rules, owners and expirations; test allowed business flows and blocked unauthorized paths.
deployment_assumptions: a workload network policy or cloud resource boundary is relevant

guide-cspm.title: Cloud security posture management / 云配置态势管理
primary_mechanisms: CSPM continuously detects cloud misconfiguration and policy drift across accounts
Findings need accountable owners, tracked remediation and verification; coverage and false positives should be measured.

guide-container.title: Container security / 容器与镜像安全
primary_mechanisms: Image vulnerability scanning and signature verification identify risky components and reject untrusted images before deployment; runtime isolation and permissions remain necessary
Container hardening minimizes image contents, runs without unnecessary root or capabilities, isolates workloads and restricts network access
Verify trusted-image admission, patching and detection of suspicious runtime behavior.

guide-inventory.title: Asset inventory / 资产盘点
primary_mechanisms: Inventory hardware, software and cloud resources with versions, ownership, business purpose and criticality, and continuously reconcile discovery results
Asset inventory provides the scope for vulnerability management, configuration control and incident response
Reconcile discovered assets with approved records, investigate unknown systems and remove retired resources.

guide-segmentation.title: Network segmentation / 网络分段
primary_mechanisms: Network segmentation applies deny-by-default controls between zones and validates allowed dependencies
Test east-west restrictions and management-plane isolation; a VLAN without enforced access rules is insufficient.

guide-ndr.title: Network detection and response / 网络检测与响应
primary_mechanisms: Network detection and response identifies intrusions, anomalous external communications and lateral movement from traffic, protocol behavior and connection metadata
NDR needs visibility at critical boundaries and east-west links, a baseline of legitimate traffic, and correlation with asset and identity context
Analysts investigate alerts, collect evidence and trigger tested containment workflows; encrypted traffic still offers useful metadata.

guide-tls.title: Transport encryption / 传输加密
primary_mechanisms: TLS deployment uses supported protocol versions and algorithms, validates certificate chains and hostnames, protects private keys and monitors expiry
Verify configurations and failed validation paths; encryption without authentication does not reliably prevent interception
Strict certificate validation prevents clients from connecting to impersonated servers or an intermediary using an untrusted certificate.

guide-data-classification.title: Data classification / 数据分类分级
primary_mechanisms: Data classification applies protection according to information sensitivity and business impact, with accountable owners and a maintained inventory
Data classification maps handling, storage, access, transfer, retention and disposal rules to sensitivity levels
Verify labels against actual data, train users and periodically reassess scope and accuracy.

guide-minimization.title: Data minimization and purpose limitation / 数据最小化与目的限制
primary_mechanisms: Data minimization reduces exposure by limiting fields, recipients and retention and by preferring less identifying representations where suitable
Review collection forms, processing inventories, access and deletion behavior against documented purposes.

guide-key.title: Cryptographic key lifecycle / 密钥生命周期管理
lifecycle_stages: key generation distribution use rotation revocation
primary_mechanisms: Manage cryptographic keys across secure generation, distribution, storage, authorized use, rotation, backup, recovery, revocation and destruction
Cryptographic keys need strong randomness, protected custody such as suitable KMS/HSM controls, separation of duties and auditability
Verify rotation, recovery and revocation, including dependent systems and encrypted-data access.

guide-masking.title: Tokenization and masking / 令牌化与脱敏
primary_mechanisms: Tokenization substitutes controlled surrogate identifiers for sensitive values; masking obscures sensitive fields in displays and test datasets
Tokenization and masking reduce unnecessary exposure but do not automatically make data anonymous
Protect the mapping and re-identification keys, restrict reversal and test whether combinations of retained fields can identify individuals.

guide-backup.title: Immutable backups / 不可变备份
primary_mechanisms: Isolated or immutable backup copies resist ransomware and accidental deletion, with backup administration separated from production access
Immutable backups require protected retention, monitored jobs and repeated restoration tests
Verify recovery point and recovery time objectives using representative data, not merely a successful backup-job status.

guide-integrity.title: Hash and digital-signature integrity checks / 哈希与数字签名完整性
primary_mechanisms: Hashes detect changes against a protected reference; digital signatures additionally authenticate origin with trusted keys
Verify signatures, certificate or key trust, algorithm suitability and protected baselines.

guide-retention.title: Retention and secure disposal / 数据保留与安全销毁
primary_mechanisms: Define retention periods and accountable owners based on business, contractual and applicable legal needs, then securely delete or destroy expired data with evidence
Retention schedules should address backups, replicas and legal holds
Secure disposal selects sanitization methods appropriate to the media and sensitivity, verifies completion and records authorized destruction.

guide-supplier.title: Supplier security and privacy clauses / 供应商安全与隐私条款
primary_mechanisms: Binding processor contracts allocate enforceable safeguards and accountability, permit audits and inspections, and require assistance with breach notification and privacy obligations
Specify processing scope, authorized instructions, incident cooperation and end-of-service handling rather than price alone
Guidance depends on applicable jurisdiction.

guide-transfer.title: Cross-border data transfers / 跨境传输评估
primary_mechanisms: For personal-data exports, assess the lawful processing basis, applicable transfer tool, destination law, recipient safeguards and transfer impact, documenting supplementary measures and periodic review
Exact requirements depend on jurisdiction; financial payment settlement is a different topic.

guide-dpia.title: Privacy impact assessment / 数据保护影响评估
lifecycle_stages: predeployment necessity proportionality and risk assessment
primary_mechanisms: DPIAs identify and mitigate privacy risks before deployment; consult responsible privacy specialists and revisit the assessment when the processing changes
Maintain the assessment, mitigation owners, decisions and review evidence.

guide-notification.title: Incident and breach reporting / 事件通报与泄露通知
primary_mechanisms: Incident notification supports timely internal escalation, regulatory reporting and affected-party notice when applicable, with documented responsibilities and deadlines
Incident reporting requires defined escalation thresholds, accountable decision makers, evidence preservation, approved communication templates and exercises
Notification duties and deadlines depend on the applicable law and facts; avoid treating one jurisdiction's limit as universal.

guide-siem.title: Central log correlation / 集中日志关联
primary_mechanisms: Central log correlation connects host, network, application and identity events using consistent fields, time and entities to reveal attack chains
SIEM needs reliable ingestion, synchronized time, protected retention, detection rules, tuning and triage workflows
Verify coverage and correlation through representative end-to-end tests and tracked incident investigations.

guide-ir.title: Incident response playbooks / 事件响应预案
lifecycle_stages: preparation detection containment eradication recovery lessons
primary_mechanisms: Incident response playbooks define decision authority, coordination, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery and communications for security incidents
Incident response playbooks should define decision authority, evidence handling and recovery criteria, with coordination across technical, business and legal roles
Exercises and real incidents produce lessons, updated procedures and verified corrective actions.

guide-risk.title: Risk assessment / 风险评估
failure_modes: priorities detached from likelihood and business impact
primary_mechanisms: Risk assessment defines scope and criteria, identifies threats and vulnerabilities, evaluates likelihood and impact, and assigns accountable risk owners
Risk assessment supports prioritized treatment and documented acceptance of residual risk
Review changes and evidence periodically; counting vulnerabilities alone does not establish business risk.

guide-awareness.title: Security awareness exercises / 安全意识培训与演练
lifecycle_stages: learning practice feedback and effectiveness measurement
primary_mechanisms: Security awareness is reinforced by role-relevant practice, reporting procedures and feedback
Measure reporting quality, repeated mistakes and follow-up improvements rather than attendance alone.

guide-third-party.title: Third-party and supplier risk management / 第三方与供应商风险管理
primary_mechanisms: Supplier reviews prioritize critical services and sensitive data, establish security and notification requirements, monitor changes and verify revocation and data return or deletion at termination
Evidence includes assessments, contract commitments, review results and tracked remediation.

guide-recovery.title: Business continuity and recovery exercises / 业务连续性与灾难恢复演练
failure_modes: unmet recovery time and point objectives
primary_mechanisms: Continuity and disaster recovery exercises test dependency assumptions, RTO/RPO and restoration procedures through tabletop and technical scenarios
Record gaps, assign remediation and repeat tests to verify improvements.

guide-change.title: Change control / 变更控制
primary_mechanisms: Assess the security and business impact of changes, obtain approval, test, schedule deployment and prepare rollback before implementation
Configuration change control separates request, approval and execution where warranted and confirms the resulting state
Emergency changes still require tracking and timely retrospective review; retain test, authorization and verification evidence.

guide-ddos.title: DDoS mitigation and rate limiting / DDoS缓解与速率限制
primary_mechanisms: DDoS defenses maintain network and application availability under abusive traffic while preserving legitimate business access
DDoS mitigation filters or absorbs abusive traffic before critical resources saturate, with upstream coordination, resource quotas, rate limiting and tested failover
Establish normal traffic baselines, tune thresholds and exercise response plans without blocking legitimate demand.

guide-dns.title: DNS security monitoring / DNS安全监测
primary_mechanisms: Centralize DNS query and response logs; correlate reputation, frequency, novel names and entropy to detect tunneling while preserving host and investigation context
DNS monitoring can expose malicious-domain communications, suspicious new domains and DNS tunneling through query and response analysis
DNS security monitoring correlates query logs, reputation and anomalies with assets and identity, then investigates and blocks verified malicious activity
Protect resolver configurations, validate DNSSEC where applicable and review false positives; monitoring and DNS authenticity address different risks.

guide-cloud-audit.title: Centralized cloud audit logging / 云审计日志集中化
lifecycle_stages: cloud audit collection and protected retention
primary_mechanisms: Cloud audit logs record control-plane API calls, identity activity and resource changes across accounts and regions for attribution and investigation
Centralized cloud audit logging needs organization-wide coverage, synchronized timestamps, protected retention, restricted deletion, integrity controls and actionable alerts
Verify ingestion, identity attribution and end-to-end investigation through test events.

guide-cloud-iam.title: Cloud IAM least privilege / 云身份最小权限
primary_mechanisms: Use resource-, action- and condition-specific grants with workload identities or short-lived credentials, reviewing trust policies and cross-account access
Cloud IAM least privilege avoids broad wildcard actions and resources, separates duties and continuously reviews effective permissions and unused grants
Test allowed business operations and denial of escalation paths, and rotate or revoke exposed credentials promptly.

guide-cloud-kms.title: Managed key services / 托管密钥服务
lifecycle_stages: managed key generation use rotation revocation
primary_mechanisms: Managed key services centralize key protection and lifecycle operations, often using envelope encryption and hardware-backed safeguards
Separate key administration from data use, restrict decrypt permissions and test recovery, rotation and revocation; a KMS does not correct overly broad application permissions automatically.

guide-dlp.title: Data loss prevention / 数据防泄漏
primary_mechanisms: DLP identifies and blocks unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive information through endpoint, email, network and cloud channels
Data loss prevention detects and controls sensitive-data movement with inspection, policy enforcement, blocking or alerting and approved exceptions
Cover relevant channels, tune classifiers and test both prohibited transfers and legitimate workflows; investigate incidents and review false positives.

guide-rest-encryption.title: Encryption at rest / 静态数据加密
primary_mechanisms: Protect stored plaintext in disks, storage snapshots, database files and backups against unauthorized disclosure when those copies leak
Encryption at rest reduces exposure from lost media or unauthorized storage access, using appropriate cryptography and protected keys
Inventory sensitive stores, enable encryption, restrict decrypt authority and verify key rotation, access logging and recovery
Encryption is not a substitute for application authorization or data minimization.

guide-host-backup.title: Host backup and restore testing / 主机备份与恢复验证
primary_mechanisms: Recover critical data, configurations and host state after ransomware, accidental deletion or hardware damage, limiting business disruption
Host backup and restore testing verifies recoverability, clean system state and required recovery time and recovery point objectives
Test representative restores, document failures and fix gaps; backups without verified restoration are insufficient assurance.

guide-rbac.title: Role-based access control / 基于角色的访问控制
primary_mechanisms: Role-based access control maps job responsibilities to approved permission bundles, with separation-of-duties constraints and periodic membership review
Avoid oversized roles, govern role changes and verify access when employees join, transfer or leave.

guide-endpoint-privilege.title: Endpoint least privilege / 终端最小权限
primary_mechanisms: Endpoint least privilege removes unnecessary local administrator rights, separates administrative and everyday identities, and grants time-limited elevation only after approval
Monitor privileged actions, review exceptions and test that routine applications work without excessive rights.

guide-sast-dast.title: Static and dynamic application security testing / 静态与动态安全测试
primary_mechanisms: Shift security testing before release by combining static analysis, dependency checks and dynamic tests in the pipeline, with remediation gates for high-risk findings
SAST inspects code for insecure patterns while DAST exercises deployed application behavior; neither alone proves absence of vulnerabilities
Integrate tests into development and release gates, triage findings, assign owners, remediate and retest confirmed flaws.

guide-memory.title: Memory safety / 内存安全语言与防护
primary_mechanisms: Memory safety reduces memory-corruption defects, including out-of-bounds access and use-after-free flaws, rather than merely making exploitation harder
Memory-safe languages prevent broad classes of memory corruption; mitigations such as ASLR, non-executable memory and stack protections reduce exploitability in remaining unsafe components
Minimize unsafe interfaces, test parsers and verify build-hardening settings
Mitigation features do not repair the underlying defect.
deployment_assumptions: implementation can be changed; prevention of implementation defects is requested

guide-sandbox.title: Sandbox isolation / 沙箱隔离
primary_mechanisms: Restrict untrusted parsers and code with separate low-privilege execution, file and network access limits, system-call restrictions and resource quotas
Sandbox isolation uses strong boundaries and least privilege with resource limits, monitored interfaces and controlled data exchange
Patch the isolation layer and test escape resistance; process separation alone is not sufficient when shared privileges remain broad.
deployment_assumptions: runtime isolation is available; containment does not repair implementation defects

guide-secure-boot.title: Secure boot / 安全启动
primary_mechanisms: Before the operating system loads, verify firmware and bootloader components against protected trust anchors; combine signature checks with version/rollback policy and protected recovery secrets
Secure boot establishes a verified chain of trust through signed boot components and controlled trust anchors
Protect enrollment and update keys, manage revocation and recovery, and test rejection of unsigned or modified components
Measured boot records measurements and is distinct from enforcing signature checks.

guide-firmware.title: Verified firmware updates / 固件更新与验证
primary_mechanisms: Verified firmware updates patch low-level flaws while rejecting forged updates and unauthorized rollback to vulnerable firmware versions
Verified firmware updates authenticate the update and its integrity, enforce authorized versions and resist malicious rollback
Maintain an inventory and update records, validate installation and ensure the recovery image and trust keys cannot be silently replaced.

guide-random.title: Cryptographically secure randomness / 密码学安全随机数
primary_mechanisms: Cryptographically secure randomness provides unpredictability for keys, tokens and authentication challenges; randomness alone does not guarantee uniqueness
Cryptographically secure randomness requires suitable entropy, a vetted CSPRNG or DRBG, secure initialization and protection against state reuse
Use operating-system cryptographic randomness APIs and test error handling; uniqueness and unpredictability are separate requirements.

guide-time.title: Trusted time synchronization / 可信时间同步
primary_mechanisms: Consistent trusted time supports event ordering, cross-system log correlation, certificate validation and token-expiry decisions
Trusted time synchronization uses approved time sources, protected synchronization and monitored clock drift
Restrict source changes, handle time failures and verify timestamps across systems; inconsistent or manipulated clocks can undermine investigations and security decisions.
